item.title: Surfaces, Vol. 9, Pages 29: Cyclic Voltammetry-Assisted Electrodeposition of TiO2/PANI Thin Films on Boron-Doped Diamond and Fluorine-Doped Tin Oxide: Effect of Composition on Interfacial and Electrochemical Properties
item.description: 该论文通过循环伏安法在硼掺杂金刚石和FTO基底上电沉积TiO2/PANI薄膜，研究了组成对界面和电化学性能的影响。
item.dc:creator: Robert Josep Villanueva-Silva
Ulises Páramo-García
Ricardo García-Alamilla
Luis Alejandro Macclesh del Pino-Pérez
Joel Moreno-Palmerin

item.title: Ceramics, Vol. 9, Pages 31: Experimental Study on Cutting Edge Preparation of Zirconia-Toughened Aluminum Oxide Ceramic Inserts Using Abrasive Brushing Tools
item.description: 该论文实验研究了使用含金刚石磨粒的刷磨工具对氧化锆增韧氧化铝陶瓷切削刃进行边缘制备，分析了工艺参数对边缘圆角的影响。
item.dc:creator: Eckart Uhlmann
Xinyu Zhang
Anton Hoyer

item.title: Chips, Vol. 5, Pages 4: A Review of Thermal Management Techniques Adopted for High-Power-Density GaN-Based Converters
item.description: 该论文综述了高功率密度GaN转换器的热管理技术，包括使用金刚石等新型材料改善散热，分析了热边界电阻和基底选择对热性能的影响。
item.dc:creator: Mohamed Belguith
Sonia Eloued
Moncef Kadi
Jaleleddine Ben Hadj Slama
Mahmoud Hamouda

item.title: Surfaces, Vol. 8, Pages 85: Impact of Mo Substrate Roughness on the Stability and Properties of Diamond Films for Aerospace Applications
item.description: 该论文研究了在粗糙度不同的钼基底上通过微波等离子体增强化学气相沉积生长金刚石薄膜，探讨了表面粗糙化对附着力和残余应力的影响。
item.dc:creator: Luciano Velardi
Grazia Cicala
Antonio Della Torre
Luca Nunzio Francioso
Maria Assunta Signore

item.title: Electrochem, Vol. 6, Pages 41: A New Hope for All-Diamond Electrodes? The Interdigitated Double Diamond Electrode
item.description: 该论文提出了一种陶瓷基硼掺杂金刚石电极，用于电化学高级氧化过程处理水中的新兴污染物，相比传统BDD技术能耗更低。
item.dc:creator: Manuel Zulla
Carolin Messerschmidt
Hanadi Ghanem
Johannes Bähr
Lukas Hegemann
Stefan Rosiwal

item.title: Instruments, Vol. 9, Pages 26: A Broad Photon Energy Range Multi-Strip Imaging Array Based upon Single Crystal Diamond Schottky Photodiode
item.description: 该论文报道了一种基于单晶金刚石肖特基光电二极管的多条带成像阵列，用于极紫外到软X射线的成像，展示了金刚石在光电探测中的应用。
item.dc:creator: Claudio Verona
Maurizio Angelone
Marco Marinelli
Gianluca Verona-Rinati

item.title: Electrochem, Vol. 6, Pages 23: Alternative Supports for Electrocatalysis of the Oxygen Evolution Reaction in Alkaline Media
item.description: 该论文比较了硼掺杂金刚石（BDD）与其他载体在碱性介质中析氧反应电催化中的稳定性和性能，表明BDD是最稳定的载体。
item.dc:creator: Gwénaëlle Kéranguéven
Ivan Filimonenkov
Thierry Dintzer
Matthieu Picher

item.title: Solids, Vol. 6, Pages 24: Diamond-Based Solvated Electron Generators: A Perspective on Applications in NRR, CO2RR, and Pollutant Degradation
item.description: 该论文探讨了基于金刚石的溶剂化电子发生器在氮还原、二氧化碳还原和污染物降解中的应用，强调了金刚石的负电子亲和势和可调电子性质。
item.dc:creator: Mattia Cattelan

item.title: Instruments, Vol. 9, Pages 9: X-Ray and UV Detection Using Synthetic Single Crystal Diamond
item.description: 该论文综述了基于微波等离子体化学气相沉积生长的合成单晶金刚石在X射线和紫外探测中的应用，涵盖其物理性质、探测器结构及性能。
item.dc:creator: Maurizio Angelone
Francesca Bombarda
Silvia Cesaroni
Marco Marinelli
Angelo Maria Raso
Claudio Verona
Gianluca Verona-Rinati

item.title: Instruments, Vol. 8, Pages 54: A 3D Printed Air-Tight Cell Adaptable for Far-Infrared Reflectance, Optical Photothermal Infrared Spectroscopy, and Raman Spectroscopy Measurements
item.description: 该论文介绍了一种3D打印的密封样品池，用于在受控气氛下进行远红外反射、光热红外和拉曼光谱测量，适用于对空气敏感的电化学材料表征。
item.dc:creator: Annalisa Paolone
Arcangelo Celeste
Maria Di Pea
Sergio Brutti
Ferenc Borondics
Francesco Capitani
